assets.name: Wheeled armored scout Vanguard
assets.description: A fast wheeled armored scout vehicle built to probe contested ground ahead of a landing party. Light armor, a sensor mast and a single mounted phaser emplacement.

assets.name: Armored personnel carrier Bulwark
assets.description: A tracked armored personnel carrier that moves a security detail through an active combat zone. Stowed in a cargo bay of the Enterprise between deployments.

assets.name: Tracked assault vehicle Juggernaut
assets.description: A heavy tracked assault vehicle from an earlier generation of ground combat equipment. Retired from service and kept in a depot.

assets.name: Away-team communications kit
assets.description: A portable kit of comm badges, a relay unit and spare power cells for an away team that has to keep a channel open far from its ship. Used in negotiation and contact missions.

assets.name: Type-2 hand phaser
assets.description: A standard hand-held phaser with stun, heat and disruptor settings. Issued from the Enterprise armory.

assets.name: Type-3 phaser rifle
assets.description: A long-barreled phaser rifle with a longer range and a heavier power cell than the hand phaser. Carried in the armored personnel carrier Bulwark.

assets.name: Type-1 phaser
assets.description: A small palm-sized phaser of the older Type-1 pattern. Withdrawn from issue and kept as a reference piece.

assets.name: Standard tricorder
assets.description: A hand-held tricorder for general scanning, recording and analysis. Part of the equipment locker of the exploration rover Wanderer.

assets.name: Geological tricorder
assets.description: A tricorder tuned for rock, soil and mineral scans. Rides in the survey rover Pathfinder.

assets.name: Operations comm badge
assets.description: A single comm badge of the standard pattern, worn on the uniform. Not assigned to a vehicle.

assets.name: Universal translator comm unit
assets.description: A comm unit with a built-in universal translator. Waiting for a replacement translation matrix.

assets.name: Stellar cartography sensor array
assets.description: A deep-field sensor array that feeds the stellar cartography lab of the Enterprise. Used to chart unexplored systems.

assets.name: Portable spectrometer
assets.description: A portable spectrometer for the analysis of samples in the field. Mounted in the geological rover Strata.

assets.name: Ressikan flute
assets.description: A small wooden flute of Ressikan make, kept by the captain. It plays a simple melody and carries a long story.

assets.name: Violin from the ship's music collection
assets.description: A well-kept violin from the instrument collection on the Enterprise. Lent out to crew who play.

assets.name: Trombone from the ship's music collection
assets.description: A brass trombone played at off-duty jazz sessions in the ship's lounge.

assets.name: Shuttle sensor suite
assets.description: A removable sensor suite for survey, search and recovery work: long-range scanners, a particle analyzer and a recording unit. Fitted aboard a shuttle when a mission calls for it.

assets.name: Medical tricorder kit
assets.description: A medical tricorder with its scanning probes, a hypospray tray and a case. Used for emergency treatment and relief missions.

assets.name: Engineering diagnostic kit
assets.description: A kit of diagnostic probes and analyzers for tracing faults in ship systems and contaminated circuits. Its whereabouts are unknown.

assets.name: Geological rover Strata
assets.description: A six-wheeled rover built for geological sampling. In the workshop for a drive repair.

assets.name: Survey rover Pathfinder
assets.description: A small survey rover that a shuttle can carry down to a planet surface. Used to scout a landing zone before an away team follows.

assets.name: Exploration rover Wanderer
assets.description: A pressurized exploration rover with room for a small team and its equipment. Stowed in a cargo bay of the Enterprise.

assets.name: Shuttlecraft Magellan
assets.description: A standard shuttlecraft carried in the shuttlebay of the Enterprise. The usual carrier of the shuttle sensor suite.

assets.name: Shuttlecraft Sakharov
assets.description: A standard shuttlecraft carried in the shuttlebay of the Enterprise. Flown on many rescue, recovery and relief missions.

assets.name: Shuttlecraft Onizuka
assets.description: A standard shuttlecraft that was lost with all hands and confirmed destroyed. It is kept on record because earlier missions refer to it.

assets.name: Shuttlecraft Goddard
assets.description: A standard shuttlecraft undergoing a thruster overhaul in the shuttlebay.

assets.name: Shuttlecraft Cousteau
assets.description: A standard shuttlecraft carried by the USS Phoenix. It can also carry the survey rover Pathfinder.

assets.name: USS Stargazer
assets.description: A Constellation-class starship from an earlier era of the fleet. Retired and preserved.

assets.name: USS Enterprise NCC-1701-D
assets.description: A Galaxy-class starship and the flagship of the fleet in this lab. Carries shuttles, rovers, armored vehicles and equipment, and appears in most of the missions.

assets.name: USS Brattain
assets.description: A starship reported overdue. Its whereabouts are unknown and a search is on record.

assets.name: USS Phoenix
assets.description: A starship in dry dock for a warp coil replacement. Carries the shuttlecraft Cousteau.

assets.name: USS Hood
assets.description: A starship confirmed destroyed. Kept on record as a lost vessel.

cases.expected: A Missions-referenced asset that Assets holds with a live status. The reference resolves: the federation shows RESOLVED with the asset, and GET /assets/{id} answers 200.

cases.consumerShows: UNRESOLVED with asset null, as data
cases.expected: A Missions-referenced id that Assets does not hold. GET /assets/{id} answers 404 ASSET_NOT_FOUND and the federation shows the reference as UNRESOLVED with asset null; nothing is hidden or guessed.

cases.consumerShows: RESOLVED with the asset and its status
cases.expected: A Missions-referenced asset with the status DESTROYED. It resolves with its status; no judgment is made about timing.

cases.consumerShows: RESOLVED with the asset and its status
cases.expected: A Missions-referenced asset with the status MISSING. It resolves with its status; no judgment is made about timing.

cases.consumerShows: RESOLVED when asked for; no mission lists it
cases.expected: An asset that no mission of the Missions release 1.0 uses. It resolves, and GET /missions?assignedAssetId=<id> returns no mission.

cases.assetsAnswers: 200 with the record, parentAssetId naming the next asset up
cases.consumerShows: each asset RESOLVED, with its parents in the same query
cases.expected: Each chain lists the assets from the child to the top. A mission, its assets and each asset's parents answer in one federated query; every parent exists and is a VEHICLE.

consumerRule: Only a 404 ASSET_NOT_FOUND from Assets maps to UNRESOLVED. Any other failure of the lookup (a 500, a timeout, the service being down, or a 400 for a malformed id) is a lookup failure: the consumer shows an error entry with a null asset and never shows UNRESOLVED, so an outage cannot pass for a dataset of missing assets.

EQ-108.note: A cargo module: no equipment kind of the contract fits it, so Assets leaves it out on purpose.

EQ-97.note: An isolation kit that Assets leaves out on purpose.

idConvention.VS: STARSHIP (Missions release 1.0 uses VS-31 for the Enterprise)
idConvention.SH: SHUTTLE (Missions release 1.0 uses SH-42 and SH-53)
idConvention.EQ: any of the five equipment kinds (Missions release 1.0 uses EQ-64, EQ-75, EQ-86, EQ-97, EQ-108 and EQ-119)

sources.inspiration: Names and roles are inspired by Star Trek: The Next Generation; reported from general knowledge and not verified against Memory Alpha during this slice.
sources.synthetic: Every description, status, parent and id is synthetic lab content. Nothing here claims canon.
